name: The Curious Case of...
description: Take a deep dive into real-life scandals, exposing bizarre secrets, shattered lives, and twisted motives. Led by Beth Karas, each gripping story uncovers deceit, greed, and manipulation, proving truth is far more chilling than fiction.

videos.title: Bam Margera
videos.overview: As Bam grapples with addiction, BJ attacks the motives of his conservator.

videos.title: The Girl Who Died Twice
videos.overview: In 1981, 13-year-old Mary Day vanishes, and investigators suspect her stepfather may have killed her, but they never recover her body. Decades later, a woman claiming to be Mary appears, stirring suspicion and debate. Is this Mary Day or an imposter?

videos.title: The Orphan Impostor
videos.overview: Master conman Nicholas Rossi fakes his death to evade justice, adopts new identities, and leaves a trail of alleged crimes across continents. Now resurfaced as "Arthur Knight," he spins his most audacious con in court.

videos.title: The Funeral Home of Horrors
videos.overview: Jon and Carie Hallford's "Return to Nature" promises eco-friendly care but instead leaves bodies decomposing in filth and provides families with concrete instead of ashes. When investigators arrive, the Hallfords flee, leaving families demanding justice and answers.

videos.title: Jodi Hildebrandt
videos.overview: Therapist Jodi Hildebrandt's crusade against masturbation drives a wedge between couples in crisis. She forms a dark alliance with Mormon mommy vlogger Ruby Franke, but a horrifying 911 call exposes the depths of their bizarre beliefs.

videos.title: The Doomsday Cat Cult
videos.overview: Self-proclaimed prophet Sheryl Ruthven’s cat-centered cult traps followers in financial ruin, isolation, and bizarre rituals, tearing families apart and exploiting loyalty - all under the promise of salvation. As homes overflow with cats, her demands escalate, allegedly to murder, binding followers in a dark web of fanaticism and shattered lives.

videos.title: Death by Detox?
videos.overview: A wellness guru promises cures through clean living, but patients at his ranch endure unsterile care, false hope, and dangerous treatments. As families uncover the truth, investigators reveal a charismatic fraud whose "miracles" left real harm behind.

videos.title: The Killer Cheesecake
videos.overview: A shared cheesecake leaves a woman near death. As detectives link her case to another poisoning, they uncover a fugitive using charm and a rare sedative to rob and reinvent herself. A hunt across New York exposes a chilling impostor.

videos.title: Skincare Queen & the Hitman, Part 1
videos.overview: A celebrity facialist says a stalker torments her in L.A.'s brutal beauty world. As her story unravels, so do her lies until police reveal the shocking twist. Nothing in this case is what it seems.

videos.title: Skincare Queen & the Hitman, Part 2
videos.overview: A celebrity facialist spirals after online attacks and stalking she believes are by a rival; when her supposed tormentors turn out to be friends, the case becomes a story of revenge and an alleged murder-for-hire plot that upends all assumptions.
